Definition
[Green's function] ↗ def:fundamental-solution-laplace 1. ch2:2.2.4-def-1\group Green’s Functions

Green's function for $U$ is \[ G(x,y):=\Phi (y-x)-\varphi ^x(y) \qquad (x,y\in U,\ x e y). \]

Green's identity on $U\setminus B(x,\varepsilon )$, followed by $\varepsilon \downarrow 0$, gives for $u\in C^2(\overline U)$ \[ u(x)=-\int _{\partial U}u(y) rac{\partial G}{\partial u }(x,y)\, dS(y) -\int _U G(x,y)\Delta u(y)\, dy. \]
